title: Translation invariance of cube averages
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $F$ be a real-valued function on the vector space of $n$-tuples over the field with two elements, and let $z$ be any such tuple. Then the uniform average of $F(z+x)$ over all tuples $x$ equals the uniform average of $F(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is real-valued on the binary cube
$z$ is a point of the binary cube
